title: Volatility model review knowledge
scope: Evidence and package boundaries for deterministic daily volatility forecasts.
guidance: Require the selected forecast and every candidate outcome to cite the same snapshot and forecast origin.
Treat candidate failure as evidence and never infer a replacement model from package defaults.
Use the owner specification for formulas, windows, selection, units, and tolerances.
assumptions: The deterministic Quant port has already validated point-in-time input availability.
warnings: Package API documentation does not authorize changing a risk-model parameter.
